description: EnergyModelsBase provides the core Julia package used to build EnergyModelsX models of systems with multiple energy carriers. The EnergyModelsX contributors develop generation, conversion and storage representations for optimisation of energy-system operations. The README also describes extension to investment decisions and additional technologies. Coverage is defined by the model the user builds; the package does not prescribe a country, historical period or universal spatial or temporal resolution. Users obtain source code from GitHub and can inspect commented minimum working examples and the linked documentation. The repository metadata states the MIT licence, so the software is free to reuse. A limitation is that the core package is a modelling foundation, not a ready-calibrated regional system: technologies, inputs and extensions must be selected for each application. It supports operational optimisation and, with extensions, capacity planning. Related records model-pypsa and model-calliope provide other energy-system modelling tools. The earlier IndustryDHFlex draft uses EnergyModelsX, but is a specific downstream application, not a parent catalogue entry for this core package. No optimisation run was performed.
name: EnergyModelsBase (core of EnergyModelsX)
